hooks.text: 自研SwarmTech可让屏幕同时呈现超过7万名敌方单位的梦魇浪潮
hooks.excerpt: Leveraging an internally developed technology called ‘SwarmTech’ allows the game to render over 70,000 enemy units on the screen at one time.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 用光照夺回程序生成领土，对抗会藏匿敌人并持续吸取部队生命的活体死亡雾
hooks.excerpt: Light up a rich, complex, procedurally generated map to claim territory back from ‘The Veil’. A dynamic living death fog that conceals enemies and drains life from your troops.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每次死亡之夜随机施加恶咒；成功守住后再从三个祝福中选择反击力量
hooks.excerpt: Borrowing from the the roguelite genre, Malices are random afflictions placed on the player during every Death Night, unraveling the best made plans. Conversely, if a Death Night is survived, you may decide between three randomly selected Blessings, enriching the experience and giving your army a much needed edge.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
